policy: Time-boxed, documented exceptions to the licence gate in scripts/repo_check.py. Every entry MUST carry reason + owner + remediation + expires (ISO date). An EXPIRED entry is treated as a hard failure by the gate. Exceptions are not suppression: they are tracked remediation debt surfaced on every CI run.

closed.resolution: Removed the GPL-3.0-only engine entirely. Replaced by project_source/services/tts_engines.js, which loads permissive engines only: msedge-tts (MIT, primary) then node-edge-tts (MIT, fallback). Both are optional at runtime — absence degrades gracefully. Verified end-to-end: real 37 KB MP3 synthesized through msedge-tts.
